name: blocking-float-money
description: AGENTS.md marks integer cents as blocking. The new totalWithVat converts to euros, multiplies by a float rate and converts back without rounding: 19.99 EUR at 19% returns 2378.81 'cents'. Violation and real bug in one line.
agents_md:
# checkout-web

- TypeScript, React 18.
- [blocking] Money is integer cents (`Cents`) end to end; never do arithmetic on amounts as floating-point euros.

expected.why: The total is computed in floating-point euros and returned unrounded as Cents, which the blocking rule forbids and which yields fractional cents.
